_readme.what: Every structure's spawn rate, in one file. A GROUP is one shared structure_set (creativeengineering:group/<name>) holding every structure in the structure tag group/<name> (structure_tags.json): all members share its grid, so no two of them ever start closer than its separation, whatever mod they come from. Every structure that is in no group keeps its own set and is tuned under "standalone". Rejoin the world to apply (new chunks only); structure_tag_report.md shows what the game applied.
_readme.group placement: spacing: one grid slot per spacing x spacing chunks (the group's top density). separation: minimum chunks between any two members. salt: which grid (leave it). Optional: spread_type, frequency (chance per slot for the whole group), locate_offset, exclusion_zone {other_set, chunk_count} (keep off another set's grid slots; it checks slots, not real structures, so keep chunk_count small).
_readme.per structure: weight: who wins a slot where several members can spawn (relative, whole numbers). frequency: 0..1, chance that the winner really spawns; otherwise the slot stays empty, so lowering one never makes another more common. enabled: false removes it. Where a structure is the only member that fits the biome, it gets every slot x its frequency. fit_base: written by --fit-rates for structures in a biome fit (biome_fits.json) = the weight and frequency it had on its mod's own biome list; --fit-rates solves from it. fit_keep: true lets --fit-rates raise the weight above fit_base when new neighbours crowd the structure's biomes, so it keeps its density (the towers); others are capped instead. replaces + share: this member never wins a slot by its weight; it takes share (0..1) of the slots the named member of the same group wins and keeps, where both can stand (the vanilla swamp hut in YUNG's witch hut slots), so the two together are as common as the named one was. Keep its weight at 1. CEConfig [worldgen.systems] structureReplacements turns them off.
_readme.standalone: Keyed by the structure_set id in structure_config.json. placement: only the fields you change (spacing, separation, frequency, count, locate_offset...; the rest come from "original" in structure_config.json). structures: frequency / enabled / optional weight, same meaning as in a group.
_readme.moving a structure: Edit the group/* tags in structure_tags.json, then run python3 tools/gen_structure_groups.py: it adds the new member with a weight and frequency fitted to its mod default and leaves everything else alone. A tagged member with no entry here still works (the game fills in a rough default and flags it).
_readme.estimates: python3 tools/gen_structure_groups.py --check rewrites structure_group_estimates.md: expected structures per area for every structure, from its real biome areas.
_readme.biome_frequency: Group-level, optional: {"#biome tag" | "biome id": factor 0..1, ..., "default": factor}. Every member's frequency x the factor of the biome at its generation point (first match, else default; default 1 when left out). Rolled by patcherMod in generation and /locate alike. The vehicles: harsh 1.0, elsewhere 0.5.

priority._readme: Placement priority (patcherMod PlacementPriority, CEConfig [worldgen.systems] placementPriority): a structure whose pieces would overlap (in 3D) a structure of a higher rank never starts; it is dropped before its terrain is shaped, and its slot falls through like a wrong biome. groups: rank per group (every member gets it). structures: rank per "#tag" or id, over its group's (big settlements over villages). Same rank: no check (a group's grid keeps its members apart). Companions (meta_structures.json) rank one below their group. Groups without a rank (and standalone sets) take no part. shape: groups whose jigsaw members (the villages, also as companions) grow around higher-ranked structures instead of being dropped: those are cut out of the space the jigsaw fits pieces into, so streets end or turn at their edge; only a start piece that overlaps one still drops the whole start.

peaceful._readme: Peaceful radius (2026-10-12): no hostile structure starts with a piece within this many chunks (square, in XZ, measured from the peaceful structure's piece boxes, not its start chunk) of a peaceful one, whatever the ranks; the hostile start is dropped like a wrong biome. Peaceful structures ignore hostile ones in their own rank check and shaping. groups: radius per group (every member); structures: per "#tag" or id, over its group's. hostile: group names, "#tag"s or ids. 1 to 16 chunks. A structure both peaceful and hostile stays peaceful.
